editorial:
Imagine a world where an old grudge lasts for hundreds of years. You get to follow Damodar, a guy who was supposed to be dead but was brought back as an undead monster thanks to a nasty curse. He is on a mission to find a powerful evil artifact so he can finally wipe out the city of Izmir and everyone related to the people who killed him. It feels like a classic tabletop game come to life, with a dark fantasy vibe that keeps you wondering if the heroes can actually stop a villain who cannot truly die.

You will notice that the action is steady and the stakes feel high, though some of the special effects show their age since it is an older TV movie. The acting is solid enough to make you care about the fight between good and evil. If you love old-school fantasy adventures, you should definitely check this out. Since it is a bit older, your best bet is adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best quality, or you can try renting it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The final battle comes down to a huge clash where the heroes must stop Damodar from using the artifact. After a long fight, the heroes find a way to break the curse that keeps Damodar alive. Once the magical link to his undead state is snapped, he finally dies for good. The artifact is secured, the city of Izmir is saved from destruction, and peace returns to the land.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves D&D and old-school fantasy movies.
